name: cherry-studio
tagline_zh: 别在多个AI间来回切换了。一个工作台，300+助手随叫随到，还能让智能体自己跑任务。你只管下指令，它把活干完。
tagline_en: Stop juggling AI tabs. One studio, 300+ agents, and autonomous tasks that finish the job while you sip coffee.
desc_en: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs
why_zh: 同类工具只做聊天聚合，它把智能体调度和任务自动化做进工作流，且开源可自托管，这是真差异。
why_en: Unlike chat-only wrappers, it bakes agent orchestration and task automation into an open-source, self-hostable workflow.
